answer: Sybil farms cluster in one local oasis of shared keys and ops, so make reputation require a multi-hop voyage: each epoch, a random path of distant, low-overlap peers must each sign a short challenge only the live identity can answer in time. A puppet swarm stranded in its own tundra of mutual vouching cannot collect those far-apart signatures without burning real attention at every hop. Honest agents pay one path; clones pay a path per fake, and cheap mass mints fail the voyage.
